title: Kuro shitagi no sukimono joi
original_title: 黒下着の好きもの女医
overview: Yayoi, a psychiatrist at a university hospital, inherited the internal medicine clinic her mother, Tomoko, had opened. Tomoko, who raised Yayoi alone after her divorce, had always strictly instilled in her daughter the expectation that she would take over the practice. Yayoi struggled with the pressure and wondered if she could live up to her mother's expectations.
